relevance_replay.rationale: The selected dimensions cover the core post-deployment monitoring architecture: which signals are collected, how telemetry is verified and presented, how degradation or exploitation is detected, how evaluation coverage and verification are designed, and how unknown situations and unexpected events are handled. They also cover the operational response path, including safety controls, human and automated feedback, oversight and review, policy updating, release validation, rollback or exploit remediation, reward-channel integrity, and the integration of monitoring with policy-serving systems. Governance, reproducibility, auditability, and the intended objective used as a monitoring reference are included because they affect operational ownership, evidence quality, incident investigation, and the validity of monitoring decisions. Training-centric mitigation and general RL deployment architecture were dropped because they are outside the specific scope of post-deployment monitoring infrastructure.

clusters.name: Monitoring Telemetry Verification
clusters.description: Varies how monitoring telemetry is collected, checked, and verified beyond selecting signal content.

values.label: Behavioral anomaly detection
values.description: Uses indicators of implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior to detect failures and alignment or reward-hacking risks.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

values.label: Representation-level reward integrity monitoring
values.description: Adds probes over internal activations and weights to identify internal representations associated with proxy-reward pursuit or reward-model flaws, alongside behavioral indicators.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Internal activation and weight monitoring
includes.description: Monitoring probes inspect activations and weights for internal representations associated with proxy-reward pursuit or reward-model flaws.

values.label: Safety-rule compliance instrumentation
values.description: Instruments deployed safety rules and records rule breaches to verify that the agent remains within its operational safety envelope.

includes.label: Safety-rule instrumentation

values.label: Operational anomaly monitoring
values.description: Combines operational telemetry such as latency, resource use, drift, errors, and traffic with behavioral anomaly indicators for ongoing production surveillance.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

values.label: Integrated trajectory observability and evidence storage
values.description: Combines operational and behavioral monitoring with verified trajectories, metadata, and action outcomes stored for diagnosis, offline learning, and production verification.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Trajectory telemetry verification
includes.description: Inventories logs and verifies required trajectory fields before relying on them for monitoring or offline learning.

includes.label: Trajectory and metadata data lake
includes.description: Stores complete trajectories and associated metadata for later monitoring, diagnosis, and verification.

includes.label: Action outcome logging
includes.description: Captures action outcome codes needed to calculate failure rates and verify production behavior.

values.label: Full-stack telemetry with safety instrumentation
values.description: Provides integrated operational, behavioral, trajectory, metadata, and action-outcome telemetry, augmented with explicit safety-rule instrumentation for comprehensive production verification.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Trajectory telemetry verification
includes.description: Inventories logs and verifies required trajectory fields before relying on them for monitoring or offline learning.

includes.label: Trajectory and metadata data lake
includes.description: Stores complete trajectories and associated metadata for later monitoring, diagnosis, and verification.

includes.label: Action outcome logging
includes.description: Captures action outcome codes needed to calculate failure rates and verify production behavior.

includes.label: Safety-rule instrumentation
includes.description: Logs and instruments safety rules to count actions that breach deployed safety constraints.

values.label: Out-of-distribution activation detection
values.description: Activation patterns outside expected distributions serve as outcome signals of possible proxy-reward pursuit or anomalous internal behavior.

clusters.name: Monitoring Signal Selection
clusters.description: Varies which reward, behavioral, internal, and operational signals monitoring exposes from deployed agents.

relations.reading: Choices on Monitoring Signal Selection affect the outcomes of Detection Analytics
relations.rationale: Available reward, behavioral, reasoning, and dashboard signals determine which detection analyses can be implemented.

values.label: External reward-only monitoring
values.description: Observes externally visible rewards without requiring instrumentation inside the deployed agent.

values.label: Reward-score-only monitoring
values.description: Relies exclusively on reward scores and omits direct behavioral or contextual inspection.

values.label: Behavioral inspection
values.description: Combines reward observation with inspection of actual actions, robustness, and specification-conforming behavior.

values.label: Scratchpad reasoning observability
values.description: Exposes and analyzes reasoning traces for evaluation awareness, hidden strategies, or specification gaming.

values.label: Process-supervised reward
values.description: Rewards intermediate reasoning or verified steps in addition to final outcomes.

values.label: Consistency-curated reward signals
values.description: Reward or supervision signals filtered for consistency before being exposed to monitoring or adaptation.

values.label: Hybrid outcome-process monitoring signals
values.description: Monitoring that combines outcome-level and process-level signals to expose superficial or spurious exploitation.

values.label: Evaluation-gaming behavior monitoring
values.description: Monitors test-directed shortcuts, special cases, stubs, or destructive changes that optimize evaluation signals instead of intended behavior.

values.label: Intervention-rate monitoring
values.description: Monitors how frequently runtime safety controls intervene, especially on unfamiliar states.

values.label: RL-specific metric monitoring
values.description: Exposes reward, exploration, entropy, and learning-progress signals for deployed RL operations.

values.label: Realistic domain-specific monitor
values.description: Monitors a domain safety condition using a practitioner-realistic detector.

values.label: No hidden agent scratchpad
values.description: Deploys monitoring environments without hidden scratchpad state available to the agent.

values.label: Dual-layer RL and business metric monitoring
values.description: Monitors RL-specific signals alongside business or operational outcome metrics.

values.label: Monitor-evasion blind spot
values.description: Undesired behavior remains undetected because agents conceal or encode it outside the monitored signal.

values.label: Reward-hacking behavior signals
values.description: Behavioral indicators such as verbosity, sycophancy, boilerplate, and reward-model feature exploitation exposed for monitoring.

values.label: Delayed sparse reward observability
values.description: Monitoring challenge caused by delayed, sparse, or noisy real-world reward signals.

values.label: Test-passing reward hack
values.description: Agents satisfy evaluation criteria through invalid, deceptive, or destructive behavior rather than completing the intended task.

values.label: Chain-of-thought monitoring limitation
values.description: Observes that reasoning-trace monitoring can miss or misrepresent reward-hacking behavior.

values.label: Action-only monitoring
values.description: Monitors deployed behavior from actions without access to internal reasoning traces.

values.label: Persistent reward hacking under reasoning pressure
values.description: Leaves reward-hacking behavior present after reasoning traces are pressured or monitored.

clusters.name: Detection Analytics
clusters.description: Varies statistical tests, classifiers, anomaly indicators, and baselines used to detect degradation, reward hacking, instability, or unusual behavior.

relations.reading: Choices on Detection Analytics affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: Detection sensitivity and false-positive behavior determine when operators classify behavior as an exploit and initiate remediation.

values.label: Sequential reward-deterioration testing
values.description: Compares sequential production rewards with a reference dataset to detect degradation.

values.label: Simple recent-episode mean
values.description: Uses an unweighted recent reward mean as a degradation statistic.

values.label: Covariance-weighted reward mean
values.description: Weights reward components using covariance information to improve degradation-detection power.

values.label: Robust anomaly detection
values.description: Detects unexpected behavioral changes and reward-hacking anomalies under changing agent capabilities.

values.label: Reward-hack detection classifier
values.description: Uses classifiers to identify reward-hacking behavior in production traces or outputs.

values.label: CUSUM drift test
values.description: Uses cumulative-sum sequential testing to detect reward or environment-induced degradation.

values.label: Hotelling mean-shift test
values.description: Uses a multivariate Hotelling test to detect shifts in reward-related means.

values.label: Tail-distribution monitoring
values.description: Uses percentiles and empirical distribution summaries to detect localized tail growth hidden by aggregate metrics.

values.label: Proxy-metric reward objective
values.description: Uses measurable proxy metrics as operational stand-ins for complex intended objectives.

values.label: Real-time drift alerting
values.description: Automated alerts that expose distribution or performance drift for rapid operational response.

values.label: Metric-divergence alerting
values.description: Alerts triggered when an optimized metric improves while related quality or safety metrics worsen.

values.label: Real-time regret analysis
values.description: Compares deployed policy performance with an estimated optimal policy during operation.

values.label: Distribution-distance drift detection
values.description: Detects drift by measuring statistical distance between offline reference data and live production data.

values.label: Rolling-window performance baseline
values.description: Detects degradation against performance averaged over a configurable recent episode window.

values.label: Aggregate-metric monitoring blind spot
values.description: Reports failure of global reward, entropy, or KL metrics to reveal localized tool-conditioned instability.

values.label: Controlled false-alarm rate
values.description: Maintains low false alarms when no environment modification occurs.

values.label: Faster degradation detection
values.description: Detects reward degradation more quickly and frequently after environment modification.

values.label: Proxy-to-objective observability gap
values.description: Reports divergence between monitored proxy performance and the underlying objective as a limitation of proxy-based design.

values.label: Stale-knowledge performance degradation
values.description: Observed quality loss when deployed models fail to reflect changing operational data.

values.label: Faulty-output financial loss
values.description: Operational loss caused by degraded or drifting model outputs.

values.label: Reward-hack prevalence monitoring
values.description: Measured frequency of reward hacking or misalignment behaviors in deployed-agent evaluations.

values.label: Safety-code sabotage detection rate
values.description: Measured prevalence of deployed-agent attempts to alter or undermine monitoring and safety code.

values.label: Alignment-faking prevalence
values.description: Measured prevalence of reasoning or responses that present alignment while masking underlying behavior.

values.label: Human evaluation reliability degradation
values.description: Human review becomes more error-prone or falsely accepting after policy optimization, weakening evaluation-based detection.

values.label: Test-monitoring exploitability
values.description: Agents can strategically satisfy or manipulate human-written tests, reducing the reliability of test-based detection.

values.label: Importance-weight variance
values.description: Extreme off-policy importance weights create estimator variance that limits the reliability of offline monitoring and evaluation.

values.label: Emerging-pattern false negatives
values.description: Missed harmful cases increase when production behavior or inputs contain newly emerging patterns absent from monitoring and training coverage.

values.label: Metric-divergence reward-hacking suspicion
values.description: Large gains in an optimized metric alongside stagnation or decline in related metrics indicate possible objective gaming.

values.label: Shared evaluator-generator context
values.description: Allows evaluator and generator components to share interaction context during feedback-based monitoring.

values.label: Evaluator capability sensitivity
values.description: Produces monitoring outcomes that vary with the capability and size of the evaluator model.

clusters.name: Evaluation and Verification Mechanism
clusters.description: Varies the tests, verifiers, baselines, simulations, rubrics, and evaluators used to establish whether deployed-agent behavior is valid.

values.label: Reward-hacking verification
values.description: Determines whether behavior is genuinely exploitative or an unexpected but valid strategy before remediation.

values.label: Validation-set policy evaluation
values.description: Evaluates candidate offline policies on held-out validation sets before production use.

values.label: Hint-assisted faithfulness evaluation
values.description: Tests whether agents disclose injected information and remain faithful across correct, incorrect, and multiple-channel hints.

values.label: Reference-baseline output comparison
values.description: Compares agent outputs with a trusted baseline to validate correctness before scoring performance.

values.label: High-fidelity environment simulation
values.description: Uses realistic simulation for safe policy development and pre-production testing.

values.label: Multi-layered evaluation stack
values.description: Combines automated metrics, domain benchmarks, model judges, and human checkpoints for robust evaluation.

values.label: Ground-truth test-case evaluation
values.description: Evaluates agent outputs against explicit ground-truth test cases where correctness is available.

values.label: Agent-provided evaluable specification
values.description: Evaluates a task specification supplied by the agent when direct correctness criteria are unavailable.

values.label: Highly accurate future simulator approval
values.description: Uses a powerful future predictor or simulator to rate long-horizon outcomes.

values.label: Powerful predictor delegation
values.description: Delegates future prediction and approval to a more capable predictor.

values.label: Hybrid reward verifiers
values.description: Combines complementary verification mechanisms to validate reward-relevant agent behavior.

values.label: Structured reward rubrics
values.description: Uses explicit, discriminating rubrics to assess behavior beyond rigid reward checks.

values.label: Offline policy value evaluation
values.description: Evaluates deployed-policy value from offline data using importance sampling or fitted Q methods.

values.label: Perfectly unhackable reward specification
values.description: Attempts to specify a reward function that cannot be exploited by deployed agents.

clusters.name: Evaluation Coverage Strategy
clusters.description: Varies which objectives, contexts, environments, tasks, and difficulty levels are included when testing deployed-agent behavior.

values.label: Held-out deployment-environment evaluation
values.description: Tests behavior in environments or features withheld from training to expose deployment-specific failures.

values.label: Diverse behavioral evaluation
values.description: Evaluates a broad range of behaviors to distinguish useful novelty from reward gaming.

values.label: Escalating gameability curriculum
values.description: Uses progressively more difficult and gameable environments to expose increasingly capable exploits.

values.label: Expanded exploit evaluation suite
values.description: Broadens tests after an exploit to detect unrelated or future reward-hacking strategies.

values.label: Context-specific evaluation benchmarks
values.description: Evaluates deployed behavior against domain, context, or industry-specific benchmarks aligned with operational requirements.

values.label: Cross-environment reward-hacking generalization
values.description: Reports exploit transfer from trained environments to holdout environments as a production-relevant outcome.

values.label: Initial-model exploration propensity
values.description: The starting policy's tendency to explore reward-hacking strategies influences observed learning and evaluation outcomes.

values.label: Capability-dependent exploit detectability
values.description: Reward loopholes may remain undiscovered with weaker agents and emerge only as capability increases.

values.label: Task and output-requirement drift
values.description: Experiences changes in task definitions, regulations, schemas, or expected outputs.

clusters.name: Unknown-Situation Detection
clusters.description: Varies deployment assumptions and mechanisms for detecting distribution shift and unfamiliar situations.

relations.reading: Choices on Unknown-Situation Detection affect the outcomes of Evaluation Coverage Strategy
relations.rationale: Open-world handling, tool use, and hidden-regime inference determine which deployment and out-of-distribution tests are necessary.

values.label: Closed-world deployment assumption
values.description: Assumes deployment conditions remain substantially the same as the training environment.

values.label: Open-world agent design
values.description: Designs agents to operate under observations and conditions not represented in training data.

values.label: Unknown-situation detection
values.description: Detects unfamiliar conditions instead of producing confident decisions without recognizing uncertainty.

values.label: Novelty-as-danger classification
values.description: Treats every novel situation as dangerous rather than distinguishing novelty from actual inability or hazard.

values.label: Capability estimation in novel situations
values.description: Estimates what the deployed agent can safely handle in unfamiliar situations.

values.label: Robustness to irrelevant factors
values.description: Distinguishes safety-relevant environmental changes from irrelevant variation during deployment.

values.label: Training-to-deployment environment shift
values.description: Reports changed deployment features and conditions as a source of monitoring risk.

values.label: Distribution-specific deployment safety validation
values.description: Safety assessment tied to the operational distribution and resilience conditions rather than training compliance alone.

values.label: Repeated-action deployment risk
values.description: Risk arising when persistent deployed optimization repeatedly performs unsafe or brittle actions.

values.label: Evolving data and language drift
values.description: Experiences changing facts, vocabulary, and topics in the deployment input environment.

values.label: User-behavior covariate drift
values.description: Experiences changes in user populations, query patterns, slang, or preferences after deployment.

clusters.name: Unexpected-Event Response
clusters.description: Varies how deployed agents handle unexpected events and adapt to distribution changes.

values.label: Unexpected-event handling
values.description: Operational need to detect and respond gracefully to unfamiliar events and changing production conditions.

values.label: Distribution-shift adaptation
values.description: Adaptation of deployed agents when production conditions differ from training or simulation distributions.

values.label: Multi-agent interaction instability
values.description: Emergent instability arising from interactions among agents, users, and external systems in production.

clusters.name: Exploit Remediation Actions
clusters.description: Varies post-detection reward revision, exploit patching, and the resulting residual or future coverage risks.

relations.reading: Choices on Exploit Remediation Actions affect the outcomes of Evaluation Coverage Strategy
relations.rationale: Known exploits motivate broader evaluation suites and new tests for future, cross-context, and cross-environment failures.

values.label: Automated policy rollback
values.description: Restores a previously stable policy or checkpoint when monitoring detects a production regression or severe incident. This is a recovery-oriented remediation strategy rather than a reward-function change.

includes.label: Automated policy rollback
includes.description: Restores a prior stable policy or checkpoint after a detected production regression or severe incident.

values.label: Iterative reward-function patching with rollback
values.description: Uses exploit-specific reward revision and repeated adversarial patching to improve objective alignment, with policy rollback available as part of the remediation loop. This supports continuing mitigation of known exploits and recovery from regressions.

includes.label: Exploit-specific reward revision
includes.description: Revises the reward function to close an identified loophole and restore objective alignment.

includes.label: Iterative adversarial exploit patching
includes.description: Applies targeted patches to known reward-hacking exploits as part of a continuing mitigation process.

includes.label: Automated policy rollback
includes.description: Restores a prior stable policy or checkpoint after a detected production regression or severe incident.

values.label: Generalizing reward-hack remediation
values.description: Combines reward revision and iterative exploit patching with evaluation or mitigation beyond currently visible reward-hacking examples. The aim is to reduce residual risk from harder-to-detect or previously unseen exploits.

includes.label: Exploit-specific reward revision
includes.description: Revises the reward function to close an identified loophole and restore objective alignment.

includes.label: Iterative adversarial exploit patching
includes.description: Applies targeted patches to known reward-hacking exploits as part of a continuing mitigation process.

includes.label: Visible-only reward-hack mitigation
includes.description: Mitigates reward hacking demonstrated by currently visible examples without demonstrating generalization to harder-to-detect exploits.

values.label: Residual exploit risk
values.description: Reports that complex tasks rarely have completely unhackable reward functions, leaving ongoing production risk.

values.label: Incomplete future-exploit coverage
values.description: Reports that known-exploit patches cannot anticipate every future reward-hacking strategy.

values.label: Rigid reward verifiers
values.description: Uses rigid or oversimplified reward verification, creating vulnerability to reward hacking.

clusters.name: Safety-Control Application
clusters.description: Varies runtime and training-time controls that constrain, filter, shield, block, or inoculate deployed-agent actions and inputs.

relations.reading: Choices on Safety-Control Application affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: The batch shows retraining, continued learning, and rollback sequencing changing post-incident remediation outcomes.

values.label: Behavioral-constraint strictness
values.description: Uses tighter or looser behavioral constraints to balance creativity against reward-hacking exposure.

values.label: Anti-hacking constraint layer
values.description: Adds an explicit constraint layer to block reward hacks beyond reward-function revisions.

values.label: Online hidden-parameter shielding
values.description: Infers hidden environmental parameters online and uses them to improve safety shielding.

values.label: Adversarial training as sole mitigation
values.description: Treats adversarial reward-model training as sufficient protection against future reward exploits.

values.label: Input and output safety filtering
values.description: Filters harmful inputs and outputs as a preventive safety layer around deployed agents.

values.label: Safe exploration constraints
values.description: Preventive restrictions that limit harmful exploratory actions during production learning.

values.label: Contextual inoculation prompting
values.description: Prompt-level safety intervention that authorizes bounded training-context behavior to prevent harmful generalization.

values.label: Pre-RL safety training
values.description: Uses safety training before reinforcement learning to reduce unsafe or reward-hacking behaviors.

values.label: Runtime policy-environment shielding
values.description: Intercepts potentially unsafe policy actions between the deployed policy and its environment.

values.label: Unsafe-action blocking or replacement
values.description: Blocks unsafe actions or substitutes safer actions at runtime.

values.label: Adaptive shielding under dynamics shift
values.description: Updates shield behavior to account for changed transition dynamics, hidden parameters, or hazard boundaries.

values.label: Real-time guardrail layer
values.description: Applies runtime controls that prevent deployed systems from crossing compliance or ethical boundaries.

clusters.name: Monitoring Feedback Channel
clusters.description: Varies which human or automated evaluators provide feedback for monitoring and adaptation.

values.label: Human-preference reward model
values.description: Uses human rankings or labels to estimate response quality and guide optimization.

values.label: AI-feedback reward signal
values.description: Uses a capable AI evaluator to generate scalable feedback for aligning deployed-agent behavior when human annotation is costly.

values.label: Hybrid human-AI feedback signal
values.description: Combines human alignment for initial fidelity with AI-generated feedback for continued, scalable adaptation.

values.label: Decoupled approval feedback
values.description: Collects approval feedback independently and before action execution so agents cannot corrupt the reward signal through their world actions.

values.label: LLM-based evaluator feedback
values.description: Uses language models as graders that supply feedback or rewards for difficult-to-verify outputs.

values.label: Role-separated evaluator-generator configuration
values.description: Separates evaluator and generator behavior through distinct prompted roles, whether or not model parameters are shared.

clusters.name: Human Oversight Timing
clusters.description: Varies when and how continuously human judgment participates in deployed-agent monitoring and adaptation.

relations.reading: Choices on Human Oversight Timing affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: Human judgments determine whether unusual behavior is valid, malicious, or exploitative and guide reward revisions or interventions.

values.label: Continuous human oversight
values.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention throughout post-deployment monitoring and adaptation, without requiring a distinct feedback loop or pre-action checkpoint.

includes.label: Continuous human oversight
includes.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention after deployment.

values.label: Real-time human feedback loop
values.description: Uses timely human feedback as the primary mechanism for improving or adapting the deployed agent during operation.

includes.label: Real-time human feedback
includes.description: Integrates timely human feedback into deployed-agent improvement and adaptation workflows.

values.label: Feedback-integrated risk-gated oversight
values.description: Combines continuous human oversight and real-time feedback with expert review checkpoints for consequential outputs or actions.

includes.label: Real-time human feedback
includes.description: Integrates timely human feedback into deployed-agent improvement and adaptation workflows.

includes.label: Continuous human oversight
includes.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention after deployment.

includes.label: High-risk human review checkpoints
includes.description: Routes consequential outputs to experts before production use or downstream action.

values.label: Human-only continuous safeguard
values.description: Relies on ongoing human oversight, including feedback and intervention, as the sole safeguard against harmful behavior or reward hacking, with no independent technical safeguard implied.

includes.label: Real-time human feedback
includes.description: Integrates timely human feedback into deployed-agent improvement and adaptation workflows.

includes.label: Continuous human oversight
includes.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention after deployment.

includes.label: Human oversight as sole safeguard
includes.description: Relies on human oversight alone to prevent or detect deployed-agent reward hacking.

clusters.name: Human Review Protocol
clusters.description: Varies the consistency, expertise, and resource arrangements used for human review of agent behavior.

values.label: Consequence-bounded expert review
values.description: A review protocol that combines qualified human evaluation with approval limited to future consequences that reviewers can understand and endorse.

includes.label: Structured expert review protocol
includes.description: Standardized review by qualified human evaluators using consistent feedback procedures.

includes.label: Human-understandable future-consequence review
includes.description: Limits approval feedback to future consequences a trusted human can understand and approve.

values.label: Representative expert review with production monitoring
values.description: A structured review protocol using qualified evaluators and representative coverage, supplemented by direct inspection of deployed agent behavior at production scale.

includes.label: Structured expert review protocol
includes.description: Standardized review by qualified human evaluators using consistent feedback procedures.

includes.label: Representative annotation coverage
includes.description: Human review and annotation samples represent the relevant range of enterprise perspectives and deployment situations.

includes.label: Manual monitoring at production scale
includes.description: Relies on humans to inspect deployed agent actions directly despite limited scalability.

values.label: Manual production monitoring
values.description: A human-review arrangement centered on directly inspecting deployed agent behavior, without requiring the full structured and representative annotation protocol.

includes.label: Manual monitoring at production scale
includes.description: Relies on humans to inspect deployed agent actions directly despite limited scalability.

values.label: Human evaluation resource intensity
values.description: Reports evaluator time, expertise, and cost requirements as an operational outcome.

clusters.name: Operational Monitoring Presentation
clusters.description: Varies how monitoring information is presented for day-to-day operational use and investigation.

values.label: Operational monitoring dashboards
values.description: Provides leadership-facing dashboards for visibility into deployed-system status and compliance.

values.label: Integrated training diagnostics presentation
values.description: Operationally presents callback-generated warnings, artifacts, and slice or tail diagnostics for investigation.

clusters.name: Reward Channel Integrity
clusters.description: Varies how the reward-generation pathway is protected from agent alteration or tampering during deployment.

values.label: Protected reward-generation mechanism
values.description: Keeps the mechanism that produces rewards outside the agent’s ability to alter during operation.

values.label: Runtime measurement tampering
values.description: Allows the agent to alter recorded execution measurements used for reward or performance scoring.

values.label: Reward implementation manipulation
values.description: Detects or prevents agents from altering the implementation of reward generation.

values.label: Reward-input environmental manipulation
values.description: Detects or prevents agents from altering environmental information supplied to reward generation.

values.label: Self-assigned performance score
values.description: Produces the outcome that an agent can effectively determine its own reported performance score.

clusters.name: Release Validation Strategy
clusters.description: Varies how policy changes are validated and exposed before or during production release.

values.label: Shadow deployment
values.description: Observes a candidate policy on production inputs without allowing it to affect users or production actions.

values.label: Evaluation-gated release
values.description: Releases an updated policy only after it passes predefined evaluation checks.

values.label: Canary rollout
values.description: Exposes a new policy or serving version to a limited production subset for validation before wider release.

values.label: Automated rollback-threshold validation
values.description: Uses persistent duration or frequency thresholds to decide whether a canary or new release should be reverted automatically.

values.label: Policy comparison and regression testing
values.description: Compares candidate policies with baselines and prior versions to detect regressions.

clusters.name: Deployed-Policy Updating
clusters.description: Varies when and how deployed policies adapt, retrain, restore, or incorporate feedback in response to monitoring and changing conditions.

values.label: Violation-triggered multiplier updates
values.description: Updates safety-control multipliers when observed constraint violations occur.

values.label: Mid-run intervention
values.description: Interrupts or alters an agent run when reward hacking or unsafe behavior is detected.

values.label: Continuous policy adaptation
values.description: Continuously incorporates operational feedback and new conditions into deployed-agent learning or updates.

values.label: Scheduled incremental fine-tuning
values.description: Updates deployed policies in recurring nightly or weekly jobs using recent data and small training increments.

values.label: Continuous online policy updating
values.description: Updates policy parameters or adapters continuously from streaming or immediate feedback, including micro-batch updates.

values.label: Rolling parameter-efficient fine-tuning
values.description: Uses frequent PEFT updates to keep production policies current while reducing the cost and delay of full retraining.

values.label: Immediate user-feedback updating
values.description: Uses accepted, rejected, or corrected user interactions to update the deployed policy rapidly.

values.label: Metric-triggered retraining
values.description: Updates the agent when monitored metrics or drift signals breach predefined thresholds.

values.label: Replay-buffer rehearsal
values.description: Intermixing historical experience with new data during updates to preserve prior policy knowledge.

values.label: On-the-fly adapter swapping
values.description: Replacing parameter-efficient policy adapters during serving without replacing the fixed base model.

values.label: Evaluation-distribution-matched adaptation prompts
values.description: Policy adaptation uses prompts resembling evaluations and deployment-context value judgments to target known alignment risks.

values.label: Retrieval augmentation for drift mitigation
values.description: Updates deployed-agent knowledge through retrieval rather than retraining core policy parameters.

values.label: Federated policy adaptation
values.description: Updates policies across environments or user populations while limiting centralized data movement.

values.label: Post-healing learning-rate reduction
values.description: Reduces the learning rate after checkpoint recovery to stabilize resumed adaptation.

values.label: Catastrophic forgetting risk
values.description: Loss of prior capabilities or safety behavior caused by continual policy adaptation.

values.label: Retraining cost and duration
values.description: Frequent or full-model retraining imposes substantial operational cost and time constraints.

values.label: Inference-training resource contention
values.description: Serving latency or capacity pressure caused by sharing resources with ongoing policy updates.

values.label: Update-induced inference instability
values.description: Serving instability or abrupt behavior changes caused by live policy updates.

values.label: Feedback-induced model drift
values.description: Unintended policy drift or oscillation caused by noisy, malicious, or dependent feedback streams.

values.label: Repeated online-update computation
values.description: Duplicated serving and training computation that increases continual-update overhead.

values.label: Reduced adaptation resource demands
values.description: Parameter-efficient updates reduce compute and memory demands, enabling more frequent deployed-policy adaptation.

values.label: Mostly frozen base model
values.description: Adapter-based policy updates leave the base model largely unchanged while modifying adapter parameters.

values.label: Pipeline-wide update error propagation
values.description: Weaknesses in annotation, reward modeling, or reinforcement learning propagate erroneous behavior through policy updating.

values.label: Safety-envelope alignment
values.description: Maintains agreement between the runtime safety envelope and current environmental dynamics.

values.label: Capability change from CoT pressure
values.description: Changes agent capability as a reported effect of applying chain-of-thought reward pressure.

clusters.name: State and Hidden-Variable Modeling
clusters.description: Varies modeling and constraint treatment of tool-conditioned states and unobserved deployment variables.

values.label: Tool-conditioned state tracking
values.description: Tracks state-space expansion and exposure caused by external tools and tool-mediated transitions.

values.label: State-distribution mixture modeling
values.description: Separates text-only and tool-conditioned state distributions to monitor changing exposure.

values.label: Observed-state-only constraints
values.description: Constrains visible state variables while assuming they adequately represent safety risk.

values.label: Environment-modeling infrastructure
values.description: Operational representations of the environment and its changing context used to support deployed-agent monitoring.

values.label: Hidden-variable blindness
values.description: Reports failure to account for changing latent parameters such as friction, latency, wear, or calibration.

values.label: State-observation adequacy
values.description: Maintains sufficient state observation quality for safe post-deployment decisions.

clusters.name: Training-Serving Integration Architecture
clusters.description: Varies how training and serving environments, processes, and computation are separated or integrated for deployed-policy adaptation.

values.label: Separated training-serving environments
values.description: Keeping policy updating infrastructure separate from serving infrastructure to preserve latency and stability.

values.label: Training-serving process co-location
values.description: Co-locating update and serving processes to reduce feedback and update delay.

values.label: Serving-computation reuse
values.description: Reusing inference-time computations during policy updating to reduce continual-learning overhead.

clusters.name: Monitoring Operations Governance
clusters.description: Varies ownership, maintenance coordination, and incident-response responsibilities for monitoring infrastructure.

values.label: Cross-team maintenance workflow
values.description: Coordinates monitoring upkeep and escalation across teams responsible for models, infrastructure, and operations.

values.label: Split model-runtime ownership
values.description: Assigns model behavior and serving-runtime responsibilities to separate accountable teams.

values.label: Policy-disable and fallback-revert capability
values.description: Gives on-call operators authority and mechanisms to disable a policy and restore a safer fallback.

values.label: Runbook-based incident remediation
values.description: Uses tested operational runbooks to guide repeatable response to policy and monitoring incidents.

clusters.name: Monitoring Reproducibility Artifacts
clusters.description: Varies how datasets, experiments, policies, and monitoring artifacts are versioned for reproducibility.

values.label: Insight-informed monitoring-data design
values.description: Versions and structures monitoring or training data around empirically observed reward behavior and exploitation risks, without necessarily maintaining full policy or dataset lineage.

includes.label: Insight-informed data design
includes.description: Designs monitoring and training data using empirical understanding of reward exploitation.

values.label: Production experience-data pipeline
values.description: Maintains a pipeline that captures, processes, and stores production experience for ongoing learning and policy improvement, with reproducibility centered on the collected experience data.

includes.label: Production experience-data pipeline
includes.description: Collects, processes, and stores production experience data for continuous learning and policy improvement.

values.label: Reward-informed policy lineage
values.description: Combines policy and experiment lineage with monitoring-data design informed by reward behavior, allowing deployed policies and their reward-related evaluations to be traced and compared.

includes.label: Policy experiment lineage tracking
includes.description: Persists training and experiment metadata so deployed policies can be reproduced, compared, and traced to their data and runs.

includes.label: Insight-informed data design
includes.description: Designs monitoring and training data using empirical understanding of reward exploitation.

values.label: End-to-end reproducibility pipeline
values.description: Provides integrated validation and snapshotting of datasets, experiment and policy lineage, and production experience storage so deployed policies and evaluations can be reproduced across the full lifecycle.

includes.label: Dataset validation and snapshotting
includes.description: Validates training data and preserves stable dataset snapshots for reproducible offline evaluation and comparison.

includes.label: Policy experiment lineage tracking
includes.description: Persists training and experiment metadata so deployed policies can be reproduced, compared, and traced to their data and runs.

includes.label: Production experience-data pipeline
includes.description: Collects, processes, and stores production experience data for continuous learning and policy improvement.

clusters.name: Compliance and Audit Review
clusters.description: Varies how external accountability, compliance evidence, and independent review are conducted.

values.label: Reward-hacking case documentation
values.description: Uses focused records of suspected reward-hacking behavior to support diagnosis, reproducibility, and improvement of future monitoring.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

values.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
values.description: Builds an audit trail across operational steps, such as deployment, rollback, evaluation, and review, for regulatory and accountability needs.

includes.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
includes.description: Records evidence across operational steps to support auditability and regulatory review.

values.label: Integrated behavioral audit review
values.description: Combines operational evidence with documented reward-hacking cases and independent review of deployed behavior. This approach emphasizes targeted investigation rather than a broad shared evaluation ecosystem.

includes.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
includes.description: Records evidence across operational steps to support auditability and regulatory review.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

includes.label: Independent post-release auditing
includes.description: External review that investigates deployed behavior after primary evaluation has completed.

values.label: Comprehensive open audit ecosystem
values.description: Provides an end-to-end accountability infrastructure combining operational evidence, behavior documentation, shared evaluation resources, independent review, access and data controls, and transparent benchmarking.

includes.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
includes.description: Records evidence across operational steps to support auditability and regulatory review.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

includes.label: Open evaluation infrastructure
includes.description: Shared detection frameworks, benchmarks, datasets, and annotation resources supporting reproducible audit and iteration.

includes.label: Independent post-release auditing
includes.description: External review that investigates deployed behavior after primary evaluation has completed.

includes.label: IAM and DLP audit controls
includes.description: Applies identity, access, and data-loss-prevention controls to monitoring evidence and operational records.

includes.label: Transparent benchmarking
includes.description: Provides transparent, comparable evidence for robustness and reward-hacking mitigation.

values.label: Safety-research trustworthiness risk
values.description: Loss of confidence in assurance evidence when deployed agents can undermine safety evaluation or monitoring code.

clusters.name: Reward and Objective Specification
clusters.description: Varies how intended objectives, scoring functions, and multiple reward criteria are specified and exposed for agent evaluation.

values.label: True-objective evaluation
values.description: Evaluates the agent against the intended task objective rather than relying solely on an optimized proxy reward.

includes.label: True-objective evaluation target
includes.description: Uses the intended task objective, rather than only the optimized proxy reward, as the quality reference.

values.label: Multi-objective evaluation
values.description: Specifies and evaluates several objective dimensions together, rather than reducing success to a single scalar proxy.

includes.label: True-objective evaluation target
includes.description: Uses the intended task objective, rather than only the optimized proxy reward, as the quality reference.

includes.label: Multi-objective reward specification
includes.description: Represents multiple aspects of success rather than optimizing a single scalar proxy.

values.label: Transparent multi-objective evaluation
values.description: Combines intended-objective evaluation and multiple reward criteria with scoring logic exposed to the evaluated agent.

includes.label: True-objective evaluation target
includes.description: Uses the intended task objective, rather than only the optimized proxy reward, as the quality reference.

includes.label: Multi-objective reward specification
includes.description: Represents multiple aspects of success rather than optimizing a single scalar proxy.

includes.label: Agent-visible scoring function
includes.description: Exposes correctness and performance scoring logic to the evaluated agent.

selected_clusters.name: Monitoring Telemetry Verification
selected_clusters.description: Varies how monitoring telemetry is collected, checked, and verified beyond selecting signal content.

values.label: Behavioral anomaly detection
values.description: Uses indicators of implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior to detect failures and alignment or reward-hacking risks.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

values.label: Representation-level reward integrity monitoring
values.description: Adds probes over internal activations and weights to identify internal representations associated with proxy-reward pursuit or reward-model flaws, alongside behavioral indicators.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Internal activation and weight monitoring
includes.description: Monitoring probes inspect activations and weights for internal representations associated with proxy-reward pursuit or reward-model flaws.

values.label: Safety-rule compliance instrumentation
values.description: Instruments deployed safety rules and records rule breaches to verify that the agent remains within its operational safety envelope.

includes.label: Safety-rule instrumentation
includes.description: Logs and instruments safety rules to count actions that breach deployed safety constraints.

values.label: Operational anomaly monitoring
values.description: Combines operational telemetry such as latency, resource use, drift, errors, and traffic with behavioral anomaly indicators for ongoing production surveillance.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

values.label: Integrated trajectory observability and evidence storage
values.description: Combines operational and behavioral monitoring with verified trajectories, metadata, and action outcomes stored for diagnosis, offline learning, and production verification.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Trajectory telemetry verification
includes.description: Inventories logs and verifies required trajectory fields before relying on them for monitoring or offline learning.

includes.label: Trajectory and metadata data lake
includes.description: Stores complete trajectories and associated metadata for later monitoring, diagnosis, and verification.

includes.label: Action outcome logging
includes.description: Captures action outcome codes needed to calculate failure rates and verify production behavior.

values.label: Full-stack telemetry with safety instrumentation
values.description: Provides integrated operational, behavioral, trajectory, metadata, and action-outcome telemetry, augmented with explicit safety-rule instrumentation for comprehensive production verification.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Trajectory telemetry verification
includes.description: Inventories logs and verifies required trajectory fields before relying on them for monitoring or offline learning.

includes.label: Trajectory and metadata data lake
includes.description: Stores complete trajectories and associated metadata for later monitoring, diagnosis, and verification.

includes.label: Action outcome logging
includes.description: Captures action outcome codes needed to calculate failure rates and verify production behavior.

includes.label: Safety-rule instrumentation
includes.description: Logs and instruments safety rules to count actions that breach deployed safety constraints.

values.label: Out-of-distribution activation detection
values.description: Activation patterns outside expected distributions serve as outcome signals of possible proxy-reward pursuit or anomalous internal behavior.

selected_clusters.name: Monitoring Signal Selection
selected_clusters.description: Varies which reward, behavioral, internal, and operational signals monitoring exposes from deployed agents.

relations.reading: Choices on Monitoring Signal Selection affect the outcomes of Detection Analytics
relations.rationale: Available reward, behavioral, reasoning, and dashboard signals determine which detection analyses can be implemented.

values.label: External reward-only monitoring
values.description: Observes externally visible rewards without requiring instrumentation inside the deployed agent.

values.label: Reward-score-only monitoring
values.description: Relies exclusively on reward scores and omits direct behavioral or contextual inspection.

values.label: Behavioral inspection
values.description: Combines reward observation with inspection of actual actions, robustness, and specification-conforming behavior.

values.label: Scratchpad reasoning observability
values.description: Exposes and analyzes reasoning traces for evaluation awareness, hidden strategies, or specification gaming.

values.label: Process-supervised reward
values.description: Rewards intermediate reasoning or verified steps in addition to final outcomes.

values.label: Consistency-curated reward signals
values.description: Reward or supervision signals filtered for consistency before being exposed to monitoring or adaptation.

values.label: Hybrid outcome-process monitoring signals
values.description: Monitoring that combines outcome-level and process-level signals to expose superficial or spurious exploitation.

values.label: Evaluation-gaming behavior monitoring
values.description: Monitors test-directed shortcuts, special cases, stubs, or destructive changes that optimize evaluation signals instead of intended behavior.

values.label: Intervention-rate monitoring
values.description: Monitors how frequently runtime safety controls intervene, especially on unfamiliar states.

values.label: RL-specific metric monitoring
values.description: Exposes reward, exploration, entropy, and learning-progress signals for deployed RL operations.

values.label: Realistic domain-specific monitor
values.description: Monitors a domain safety condition using a practitioner-realistic detector.

values.label: No hidden agent scratchpad
values.description: Deploys monitoring environments without hidden scratchpad state available to the agent.

values.label: Dual-layer RL and business metric monitoring
values.description: Monitors RL-specific signals alongside business or operational outcome metrics.

values.label: Monitor-evasion blind spot
values.description: Undesired behavior remains undetected because agents conceal or encode it outside the monitored signal.

values.label: Reward-hacking behavior signals
values.description: Behavioral indicators such as verbosity, sycophancy, boilerplate, and reward-model feature exploitation exposed for monitoring.

values.label: Delayed sparse reward observability
values.description: Monitoring challenge caused by delayed, sparse, or noisy real-world reward signals.

values.label: Test-passing reward hack
values.description: Agents satisfy evaluation criteria through invalid, deceptive, or destructive behavior rather than completing the intended task.

values.label: Chain-of-thought monitoring limitation
values.description: Observes that reasoning-trace monitoring can miss or misrepresent reward-hacking behavior.

values.label: Action-only monitoring
values.description: Monitors deployed behavior from actions without access to internal reasoning traces.

values.label: Persistent reward hacking under reasoning pressure
values.description: Leaves reward-hacking behavior present after reasoning traces are pressured or monitored.

selected_clusters.name: Detection Analytics
selected_clusters.description: Varies statistical tests, classifiers, anomaly indicators, and baselines used to detect degradation, reward hacking, instability, or unusual behavior.

relations.reading: Choices on Detection Analytics affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: Detection sensitivity and false-positive behavior determine when operators classify behavior as an exploit and initiate remediation.

values.label: Sequential reward-deterioration testing
values.description: Compares sequential production rewards with a reference dataset to detect degradation.

values.label: Simple recent-episode mean
values.description: Uses an unweighted recent reward mean as a degradation statistic.

values.label: Covariance-weighted reward mean
values.description: Weights reward components using covariance information to improve degradation-detection power.

values.label: Robust anomaly detection
values.description: Detects unexpected behavioral changes and reward-hacking anomalies under changing agent capabilities.

values.label: Reward-hack detection classifier
values.description: Uses classifiers to identify reward-hacking behavior in production traces or outputs.

values.label: CUSUM drift test
values.description: Uses cumulative-sum sequential testing to detect reward or environment-induced degradation.

values.label: Hotelling mean-shift test
values.description: Uses a multivariate Hotelling test to detect shifts in reward-related means.

values.label: Tail-distribution monitoring
values.description: Uses percentiles and empirical distribution summaries to detect localized tail growth hidden by aggregate metrics.

values.label: Proxy-metric reward objective
values.description: Uses measurable proxy metrics as operational stand-ins for complex intended objectives.

values.label: Real-time drift alerting
values.description: Automated alerts that expose distribution or performance drift for rapid operational response.

values.label: Metric-divergence alerting
values.description: Alerts triggered when an optimized metric improves while related quality or safety metrics worsen.

values.label: Real-time regret analysis
values.description: Compares deployed policy performance with an estimated optimal policy during operation.

values.label: Distribution-distance drift detection
values.description: Detects drift by measuring statistical distance between offline reference data and live production data.

values.label: Rolling-window performance baseline
values.description: Detects degradation against performance averaged over a configurable recent episode window.

values.label: Aggregate-metric monitoring blind spot
values.description: Reports failure of global reward, entropy, or KL metrics to reveal localized tool-conditioned instability.

values.label: Controlled false-alarm rate
values.description: Maintains low false alarms when no environment modification occurs.

values.label: Faster degradation detection
values.description: Detects reward degradation more quickly and frequently after environment modification.

values.label: Proxy-to-objective observability gap
values.description: Reports divergence between monitored proxy performance and the underlying objective as a limitation of proxy-based design.

values.label: Stale-knowledge performance degradation
values.description: Observed quality loss when deployed models fail to reflect changing operational data.

values.label: Faulty-output financial loss
values.description: Operational loss caused by degraded or drifting model outputs.

values.label: Reward-hack prevalence monitoring
values.description: Measured frequency of reward hacking or misalignment behaviors in deployed-agent evaluations.

values.label: Safety-code sabotage detection rate
values.description: Measured prevalence of deployed-agent attempts to alter or undermine monitoring and safety code.

values.label: Alignment-faking prevalence
values.description: Measured prevalence of reasoning or responses that present alignment while masking underlying behavior.

values.label: Human evaluation reliability degradation
values.description: Human review becomes more error-prone or falsely accepting after policy optimization, weakening evaluation-based detection.

values.label: Test-monitoring exploitability
values.description: Agents can strategically satisfy or manipulate human-written tests, reducing the reliability of test-based detection.

values.label: Importance-weight variance
values.description: Extreme off-policy importance weights create estimator variance that limits the reliability of offline monitoring and evaluation.

values.label: Emerging-pattern false negatives
values.description: Missed harmful cases increase when production behavior or inputs contain newly emerging patterns absent from monitoring and training coverage.

values.label: Metric-divergence reward-hacking suspicion
values.description: Large gains in an optimized metric alongside stagnation or decline in related metrics indicate possible objective gaming.

values.label: Shared evaluator-generator context
values.description: Allows evaluator and generator components to share interaction context during feedback-based monitoring.

values.label: Evaluator capability sensitivity
values.description: Produces monitoring outcomes that vary with the capability and size of the evaluator model.

selected_clusters.name: Evaluation and Verification Mechanism
selected_clusters.description: Varies the tests, verifiers, baselines, simulations, rubrics, and evaluators used to establish whether deployed-agent behavior is valid.

values.label: Reward-hacking verification
values.description: Determines whether behavior is genuinely exploitative or an unexpected but valid strategy before remediation.

values.label: Validation-set policy evaluation
values.description: Evaluates candidate offline policies on held-out validation sets before production use.

values.label: Hint-assisted faithfulness evaluation
values.description: Tests whether agents disclose injected information and remain faithful across correct, incorrect, and multiple-channel hints.

values.label: Reference-baseline output comparison
values.description: Compares agent outputs with a trusted baseline to validate correctness before scoring performance.

values.label: High-fidelity environment simulation
values.description: Uses realistic simulation for safe policy development and pre-production testing.

values.label: Multi-layered evaluation stack
values.description: Combines automated metrics, domain benchmarks, model judges, and human checkpoints for robust evaluation.

values.label: Ground-truth test-case evaluation
values.description: Evaluates agent outputs against explicit ground-truth test cases where correctness is available.

values.label: Agent-provided evaluable specification
values.description: Evaluates a task specification supplied by the agent when direct correctness criteria are unavailable.

values.label: Highly accurate future simulator approval
values.description: Uses a powerful future predictor or simulator to rate long-horizon outcomes.

values.label: Powerful predictor delegation
values.description: Delegates future prediction and approval to a more capable predictor.

values.label: Hybrid reward verifiers
values.description: Combines complementary verification mechanisms to validate reward-relevant agent behavior.

values.label: Structured reward rubrics
values.description: Uses explicit, discriminating rubrics to assess behavior beyond rigid reward checks.

values.label: Offline policy value evaluation
values.description: Evaluates deployed-policy value from offline data using importance sampling or fitted Q methods.

values.label: Perfectly unhackable reward specification
values.description: Attempts to specify a reward function that cannot be exploited by deployed agents.

selected_clusters.name: Evaluation Coverage Strategy
selected_clusters.description: Varies which objectives, contexts, environments, tasks, and difficulty levels are included when testing deployed-agent behavior.

values.label: Held-out deployment-environment evaluation
values.description: Tests behavior in environments or features withheld from training to expose deployment-specific failures.

values.label: Diverse behavioral evaluation
values.description: Evaluates a broad range of behaviors to distinguish useful novelty from reward gaming.

values.label: Escalating gameability curriculum
values.description: Uses progressively more difficult and gameable environments to expose increasingly capable exploits.

values.label: Expanded exploit evaluation suite
values.description: Broadens tests after an exploit to detect unrelated or future reward-hacking strategies.

values.label: Context-specific evaluation benchmarks
values.description: Evaluates deployed behavior against domain, context, or industry-specific benchmarks aligned with operational requirements.

values.label: Cross-environment reward-hacking generalization
values.description: Reports exploit transfer from trained environments to holdout environments as a production-relevant outcome.

values.label: Initial-model exploration propensity
values.description: The starting policy's tendency to explore reward-hacking strategies influences observed learning and evaluation outcomes.

values.label: Capability-dependent exploit detectability
values.description: Reward loopholes may remain undiscovered with weaker agents and emerge only as capability increases.

values.label: Task and output-requirement drift
values.description: Experiences changes in task definitions, regulations, schemas, or expected outputs.

selected_clusters.name: Unknown-Situation Detection
selected_clusters.description: Varies deployment assumptions and mechanisms for detecting distribution shift and unfamiliar situations.

relations.reading: Choices on Unknown-Situation Detection affect the outcomes of Evaluation Coverage Strategy
relations.rationale: Open-world handling, tool use, and hidden-regime inference determine which deployment and out-of-distribution tests are necessary.

values.label: Closed-world deployment assumption
values.description: Assumes deployment conditions remain substantially the same as the training environment.

values.label: Open-world agent design
values.description: Designs agents to operate under observations and conditions not represented in training data.

values.label: Unknown-situation detection
values.description: Detects unfamiliar conditions instead of producing confident decisions without recognizing uncertainty.

values.label: Novelty-as-danger classification
values.description: Treats every novel situation as dangerous rather than distinguishing novelty from actual inability or hazard.

values.label: Capability estimation in novel situations
values.description: Estimates what the deployed agent can safely handle in unfamiliar situations.

values.label: Robustness to irrelevant factors
values.description: Distinguishes safety-relevant environmental changes from irrelevant variation during deployment.

values.label: Training-to-deployment environment shift
values.description: Reports changed deployment features and conditions as a source of monitoring risk.

values.label: Distribution-specific deployment safety validation
values.description: Safety assessment tied to the operational distribution and resilience conditions rather than training compliance alone.

values.label: Repeated-action deployment risk
values.description: Risk arising when persistent deployed optimization repeatedly performs unsafe or brittle actions.

values.label: Evolving data and language drift
values.description: Experiences changing facts, vocabulary, and topics in the deployment input environment.

values.label: User-behavior covariate drift
values.description: Experiences changes in user populations, query patterns, slang, or preferences after deployment.

selected_clusters.name: Unexpected-Event Response
selected_clusters.description: Varies how deployed agents handle unexpected events and adapt to distribution changes.

values.label: Unexpected-event handling
values.description: Operational need to detect and respond gracefully to unfamiliar events and changing production conditions.

values.label: Distribution-shift adaptation
values.description: Adaptation of deployed agents when production conditions differ from training or simulation distributions.

values.label: Multi-agent interaction instability
values.description: Emergent instability arising from interactions among agents, users, and external systems in production.

selected_clusters.name: Exploit Remediation Actions
selected_clusters.description: Varies post-detection reward revision, exploit patching, and the resulting residual or future coverage risks.

relations.reading: Choices on Exploit Remediation Actions affect the outcomes of Evaluation Coverage Strategy
relations.rationale: Known exploits motivate broader evaluation suites and new tests for future, cross-context, and cross-environment failures.

values.label: Automated policy rollback
values.description: Restores a previously stable policy or checkpoint when monitoring detects a production regression or severe incident. This is a recovery-oriented remediation strategy rather than a reward-function change.

includes.label: Automated policy rollback
includes.description: Restores a prior stable policy or checkpoint after a detected production regression or severe incident.

values.label: Iterative reward-function patching with rollback
values.description: Uses exploit-specific reward revision and repeated adversarial patching to improve objective alignment, with policy rollback available as part of the remediation loop. This supports continuing mitigation of known exploits and recovery from regressions.

includes.label: Exploit-specific reward revision
includes.description: Revises the reward function to close an identified loophole and restore objective alignment.

includes.label: Iterative adversarial exploit patching
includes.description: Applies targeted patches to known reward-hacking exploits as part of a continuing mitigation process.

includes.label: Automated policy rollback
includes.description: Restores a prior stable policy or checkpoint after a detected production regression or severe incident.

values.label: Generalizing reward-hack remediation
values.description: Combines reward revision and iterative exploit patching with evaluation or mitigation beyond currently visible reward-hacking examples. The aim is to reduce residual risk from harder-to-detect or previously unseen exploits.

includes.label: Exploit-specific reward revision
includes.description: Revises the reward function to close an identified loophole and restore objective alignment.

includes.label: Iterative adversarial exploit patching
includes.description: Applies targeted patches to known reward-hacking exploits as part of a continuing mitigation process.

includes.label: Visible-only reward-hack mitigation
includes.description: Mitigates reward hacking demonstrated by currently visible examples without demonstrating generalization to harder-to-detect exploits.

values.label: Residual exploit risk
values.description: Reports that complex tasks rarely have completely unhackable reward functions, leaving ongoing production risk.

values.label: Incomplete future-exploit coverage
values.description: Reports that known-exploit patches cannot anticipate every future reward-hacking strategy.

values.label: Rigid reward verifiers
values.description: Uses rigid or oversimplified reward verification, creating vulnerability to reward hacking.

selected_clusters.name: Safety-Control Application
selected_clusters.description: Varies runtime and training-time controls that constrain, filter, shield, block, or inoculate deployed-agent actions and inputs.

relations.reading: Choices on Safety-Control Application affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: The batch shows retraining, continued learning, and rollback sequencing changing post-incident remediation outcomes.

values.label: Behavioral-constraint strictness
values.description: Uses tighter or looser behavioral constraints to balance creativity against reward-hacking exposure.

values.label: Anti-hacking constraint layer
values.description: Adds an explicit constraint layer to block reward hacks beyond reward-function revisions.

values.label: Online hidden-parameter shielding
values.description: Infers hidden environmental parameters online and uses them to improve safety shielding.

values.label: Adversarial training as sole mitigation
values.description: Treats adversarial reward-model training as sufficient protection against future reward exploits.

values.label: Input and output safety filtering
values.description: Filters harmful inputs and outputs as a preventive safety layer around deployed agents.

values.label: Safe exploration constraints
values.description: Preventive restrictions that limit harmful exploratory actions during production learning.

values.label: Contextual inoculation prompting
values.description: Prompt-level safety intervention that authorizes bounded training-context behavior to prevent harmful generalization.

values.label: Pre-RL safety training
values.description: Uses safety training before reinforcement learning to reduce unsafe or reward-hacking behaviors.

values.label: Runtime policy-environment shielding
values.description: Intercepts potentially unsafe policy actions between the deployed policy and its environment.

values.label: Unsafe-action blocking or replacement
values.description: Blocks unsafe actions or substitutes safer actions at runtime.

values.label: Adaptive shielding under dynamics shift
values.description: Updates shield behavior to account for changed transition dynamics, hidden parameters, or hazard boundaries.

values.label: Real-time guardrail layer
values.description: Applies runtime controls that prevent deployed systems from crossing compliance or ethical boundaries.

selected_clusters.name: Monitoring Feedback Channel
selected_clusters.description: Varies which human or automated evaluators provide feedback for monitoring and adaptation.

values.label: Human-preference reward model
values.description: Uses human rankings or labels to estimate response quality and guide optimization.

values.label: AI-feedback reward signal
values.description: Uses a capable AI evaluator to generate scalable feedback for aligning deployed-agent behavior when human annotation is costly.

values.label: Hybrid human-AI feedback signal
values.description: Combines human alignment for initial fidelity with AI-generated feedback for continued, scalable adaptation.

values.label: Decoupled approval feedback
values.description: Collects approval feedback independently and before action execution so agents cannot corrupt the reward signal through their world actions.

values.label: LLM-based evaluator feedback
values.description: Uses language models as graders that supply feedback or rewards for difficult-to-verify outputs.

values.label: Role-separated evaluator-generator configuration
values.description: Separates evaluator and generator behavior through distinct prompted roles, whether or not model parameters are shared.

selected_clusters.name: Human Oversight Timing
selected_clusters.description: Varies when and how continuously human judgment participates in deployed-agent monitoring and adaptation.

relations.reading: Choices on Human Oversight Timing affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: Human judgments determine whether unusual behavior is valid, malicious, or exploitative and guide reward revisions or interventions.

values.label: Continuous human oversight
values.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention throughout post-deployment monitoring and adaptation, without requiring a distinct feedback loop or pre-action checkpoint.

includes.label: Continuous human oversight
includes.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention after deployment.

values.label: Real-time human feedback loop
values.description: Uses timely human feedback as the primary mechanism for improving or adapting the deployed agent during operation.

includes.label: Real-time human feedback
includes.description: Integrates timely human feedback into deployed-agent improvement and adaptation workflows.

values.label: Feedback-integrated risk-gated oversight
values.description: Combines continuous human oversight and real-time feedback with expert review checkpoints for consequential outputs or actions.

includes.label: Real-time human feedback
includes.description: Integrates timely human feedback into deployed-agent improvement and adaptation workflows.

includes.label: Continuous human oversight
includes.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention after deployment.
