includes.label: High-risk human review checkpoints
includes.description: Routes consequential outputs to experts before production use or downstream action.

values.label: Human-only continuous safeguard
values.description: Relies on ongoing human oversight, including feedback and intervention, as the sole safeguard against harmful behavior or reward hacking, with no independent technical safeguard implied.

includes.label: Real-time human feedback
includes.description: Integrates timely human feedback into deployed-agent improvement and adaptation workflows.

includes.label: Continuous human oversight
includes.description: Maintains ongoing human review and intervention after deployment.

includes.label: Human oversight as sole safeguard
includes.description: Relies on human oversight alone to prevent or detect deployed-agent reward hacking.

selected_clusters.name: Human Review Protocol
selected_clusters.description: Varies the consistency, expertise, and resource arrangements used for human review of agent behavior.

values.label: Consequence-bounded expert review
values.description: A review protocol that combines qualified human evaluation with approval limited to future consequences that reviewers can understand and endorse.

includes.label: Structured expert review protocol
includes.description: Standardized review by qualified human evaluators using consistent feedback procedures.

includes.label: Human-understandable future-consequence review
includes.description: Limits approval feedback to future consequences a trusted human can understand and approve.

values.label: Representative expert review with production monitoring
values.description: A structured review protocol using qualified evaluators and representative coverage, supplemented by direct inspection of deployed agent behavior at production scale.

includes.label: Structured expert review protocol
includes.description: Standardized review by qualified human evaluators using consistent feedback procedures.

includes.label: Representative annotation coverage
includes.description: Human review and annotation samples represent the relevant range of enterprise perspectives and deployment situations.

includes.label: Manual monitoring at production scale
includes.description: Relies on humans to inspect deployed agent actions directly despite limited scalability.

values.label: Manual production monitoring
values.description: A human-review arrangement centered on directly inspecting deployed agent behavior, without requiring the full structured and representative annotation protocol.

includes.label: Manual monitoring at production scale
includes.description: Relies on humans to inspect deployed agent actions directly despite limited scalability.

values.label: Human evaluation resource intensity
values.description: Reports evaluator time, expertise, and cost requirements as an operational outcome.

selected_clusters.name: Operational Monitoring Presentation
selected_clusters.description: Varies how monitoring information is presented for day-to-day operational use and investigation.

values.label: Operational monitoring dashboards
values.description: Provides leadership-facing dashboards for visibility into deployed-system status and compliance.

values.label: Integrated training diagnostics presentation
values.description: Operationally presents callback-generated warnings, artifacts, and slice or tail diagnostics for investigation.

selected_clusters.name: Reward Channel Integrity
selected_clusters.description: Varies how the reward-generation pathway is protected from agent alteration or tampering during deployment.

values.label: Protected reward-generation mechanism
values.description: Keeps the mechanism that produces rewards outside the agent’s ability to alter during operation.

values.label: Runtime measurement tampering
values.description: Allows the agent to alter recorded execution measurements used for reward or performance scoring.

values.label: Reward implementation manipulation
values.description: Detects or prevents agents from altering the implementation of reward generation.

values.label: Reward-input environmental manipulation
values.description: Detects or prevents agents from altering environmental information supplied to reward generation.

values.label: Self-assigned performance score
values.description: Produces the outcome that an agent can effectively determine its own reported performance score.

selected_clusters.name: Release Validation Strategy
selected_clusters.description: Varies how policy changes are validated and exposed before or during production release.

values.label: Shadow deployment
values.description: Observes a candidate policy on production inputs without allowing it to affect users or production actions.

values.label: Evaluation-gated release
values.description: Releases an updated policy only after it passes predefined evaluation checks.

values.label: Canary rollout
values.description: Exposes a new policy or serving version to a limited production subset for validation before wider release.

values.label: Automated rollback-threshold validation
values.description: Uses persistent duration or frequency thresholds to decide whether a canary or new release should be reverted automatically.

values.label: Policy comparison and regression testing
values.description: Compares candidate policies with baselines and prior versions to detect regressions.

selected_clusters.name: Deployed-Policy Updating
selected_clusters.description: Varies when and how deployed policies adapt, retrain, restore, or incorporate feedback in response to monitoring and changing conditions.

values.label: Violation-triggered multiplier updates
values.description: Updates safety-control multipliers when observed constraint violations occur.

values.label: Mid-run intervention
values.description: Interrupts or alters an agent run when reward hacking or unsafe behavior is detected.

values.label: Continuous policy adaptation
values.description: Continuously incorporates operational feedback and new conditions into deployed-agent learning or updates.

values.label: Scheduled incremental fine-tuning
values.description: Updates deployed policies in recurring nightly or weekly jobs using recent data and small training increments.

values.label: Continuous online policy updating
values.description: Updates policy parameters or adapters continuously from streaming or immediate feedback, including micro-batch updates.

values.label: Rolling parameter-efficient fine-tuning
values.description: Uses frequent PEFT updates to keep production policies current while reducing the cost and delay of full retraining.

values.label: Immediate user-feedback updating
values.description: Uses accepted, rejected, or corrected user interactions to update the deployed policy rapidly.

values.label: Metric-triggered retraining
values.description: Updates the agent when monitored metrics or drift signals breach predefined thresholds.

values.label: Replay-buffer rehearsal
values.description: Intermixing historical experience with new data during updates to preserve prior policy knowledge.

values.label: On-the-fly adapter swapping
values.description: Replacing parameter-efficient policy adapters during serving without replacing the fixed base model.

values.label: Evaluation-distribution-matched adaptation prompts
values.description: Policy adaptation uses prompts resembling evaluations and deployment-context value judgments to target known alignment risks.

values.label: Retrieval augmentation for drift mitigation
values.description: Updates deployed-agent knowledge through retrieval rather than retraining core policy parameters.

values.label: Federated policy adaptation
values.description: Updates policies across environments or user populations while limiting centralized data movement.

values.label: Post-healing learning-rate reduction
values.description: Reduces the learning rate after checkpoint recovery to stabilize resumed adaptation.

values.label: Catastrophic forgetting risk
values.description: Loss of prior capabilities or safety behavior caused by continual policy adaptation.

values.label: Retraining cost and duration
values.description: Frequent or full-model retraining imposes substantial operational cost and time constraints.

values.label: Inference-training resource contention
values.description: Serving latency or capacity pressure caused by sharing resources with ongoing policy updates.

values.label: Update-induced inference instability
values.description: Serving instability or abrupt behavior changes caused by live policy updates.

values.label: Feedback-induced model drift
values.description: Unintended policy drift or oscillation caused by noisy, malicious, or dependent feedback streams.

values.label: Repeated online-update computation
values.description: Duplicated serving and training computation that increases continual-update overhead.

values.label: Reduced adaptation resource demands
values.description: Parameter-efficient updates reduce compute and memory demands, enabling more frequent deployed-policy adaptation.

values.label: Mostly frozen base model
values.description: Adapter-based policy updates leave the base model largely unchanged while modifying adapter parameters.

values.label: Pipeline-wide update error propagation
values.description: Weaknesses in annotation, reward modeling, or reinforcement learning propagate erroneous behavior through policy updating.

values.label: Safety-envelope alignment
values.description: Maintains agreement between the runtime safety envelope and current environmental dynamics.

values.label: Capability change from CoT pressure
values.description: Changes agent capability as a reported effect of applying chain-of-thought reward pressure.

selected_clusters.name: State and Hidden-Variable Modeling
selected_clusters.description: Varies modeling and constraint treatment of tool-conditioned states and unobserved deployment variables.

values.label: Tool-conditioned state tracking
values.description: Tracks state-space expansion and exposure caused by external tools and tool-mediated transitions.

values.label: State-distribution mixture modeling
values.description: Separates text-only and tool-conditioned state distributions to monitor changing exposure.

values.label: Observed-state-only constraints
values.description: Constrains visible state variables while assuming they adequately represent safety risk.

values.label: Environment-modeling infrastructure
values.description: Operational representations of the environment and its changing context used to support deployed-agent monitoring.

values.label: Hidden-variable blindness
values.description: Reports failure to account for changing latent parameters such as friction, latency, wear, or calibration.

values.label: State-observation adequacy
values.description: Maintains sufficient state observation quality for safe post-deployment decisions.

selected_clusters.name: Training-Serving Integration Architecture
selected_clusters.description: Varies how training and serving environments, processes, and computation are separated or integrated for deployed-policy adaptation.

values.label: Separated training-serving environments
values.description: Keeping policy updating infrastructure separate from serving infrastructure to preserve latency and stability.

values.label: Training-serving process co-location
values.description: Co-locating update and serving processes to reduce feedback and update delay.

values.label: Serving-computation reuse
values.description: Reusing inference-time computations during policy updating to reduce continual-learning overhead.

selected_clusters.name: Monitoring Operations Governance
selected_clusters.description: Varies ownership, maintenance coordination, and incident-response responsibilities for monitoring infrastructure.

values.label: Cross-team maintenance workflow
values.description: Coordinates monitoring upkeep and escalation across teams responsible for models, infrastructure, and operations.

values.label: Split model-runtime ownership
values.description: Assigns model behavior and serving-runtime responsibilities to separate accountable teams.

values.label: Policy-disable and fallback-revert capability
values.description: Gives on-call operators authority and mechanisms to disable a policy and restore a safer fallback.

values.label: Runbook-based incident remediation
values.description: Uses tested operational runbooks to guide repeatable response to policy and monitoring incidents.

selected_clusters.name: Monitoring Reproducibility Artifacts
selected_clusters.description: Varies how datasets, experiments, policies, and monitoring artifacts are versioned for reproducibility.

values.label: Insight-informed monitoring-data design
values.description: Versions and structures monitoring or training data around empirically observed reward behavior and exploitation risks, without necessarily maintaining full policy or dataset lineage.

includes.label: Insight-informed data design
includes.description: Designs monitoring and training data using empirical understanding of reward exploitation.

values.label: Production experience-data pipeline
values.description: Maintains a pipeline that captures, processes, and stores production experience for ongoing learning and policy improvement, with reproducibility centered on the collected experience data.

includes.label: Production experience-data pipeline
includes.description: Collects, processes, and stores production experience data for continuous learning and policy improvement.

values.label: Reward-informed policy lineage
values.description: Combines policy and experiment lineage with monitoring-data design informed by reward behavior, allowing deployed policies and their reward-related evaluations to be traced and compared.

includes.label: Policy experiment lineage tracking
includes.description: Persists training and experiment metadata so deployed policies can be reproduced, compared, and traced to their data and runs.

includes.label: Insight-informed data design
includes.description: Designs monitoring and training data using empirical understanding of reward exploitation.

values.label: End-to-end reproducibility pipeline
values.description: Provides integrated validation and snapshotting of datasets, experiment and policy lineage, and production experience storage so deployed policies and evaluations can be reproduced across the full lifecycle.

includes.label: Dataset validation and snapshotting
includes.description: Validates training data and preserves stable dataset snapshots for reproducible offline evaluation and comparison.

includes.label: Policy experiment lineage tracking
includes.description: Persists training and experiment metadata so deployed policies can be reproduced, compared, and traced to their data and runs.

includes.label: Production experience-data pipeline
includes.description: Collects, processes, and stores production experience data for continuous learning and policy improvement.

selected_clusters.name: Compliance and Audit Review
selected_clusters.description: Varies how external accountability, compliance evidence, and independent review are conducted.

values.label: Reward-hacking case documentation
values.description: Uses focused records of suspected reward-hacking behavior to support diagnosis, reproducibility, and improvement of future monitoring.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

values.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
values.description: Builds an audit trail across operational steps, such as deployment, rollback, evaluation, and review, for regulatory and accountability needs.

includes.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
includes.description: Records evidence across operational steps to support auditability and regulatory review.

values.label: Integrated behavioral audit review
values.description: Combines operational evidence with documented reward-hacking cases and independent review of deployed behavior. This approach emphasizes targeted investigation rather than a broad shared evaluation ecosystem.

includes.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
includes.description: Records evidence across operational steps to support auditability and regulatory review.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

includes.label: Independent post-release auditing
includes.description: External review that investigates deployed behavior after primary evaluation has completed.

values.label: Comprehensive open audit ecosystem
values.description: Provides an end-to-end accountability infrastructure combining operational evidence, behavior documentation, shared evaluation resources, independent review, access and data controls, and transparent benchmarking.

includes.label: Stepwise compliance evidence
includes.description: Records evidence across operational steps to support auditability and regulatory review.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

includes.label: Open evaluation infrastructure
includes.description: Shared detection frameworks, benchmarks, datasets, and annotation resources supporting reproducible audit and iteration.

includes.label: Independent post-release auditing
includes.description: External review that investigates deployed behavior after primary evaluation has completed.

includes.label: IAM and DLP audit controls
includes.description: Applies identity, access, and data-loss-prevention controls to monitoring evidence and operational records.

includes.label: Transparent benchmarking
includes.description: Provides transparent, comparable evidence for robustness and reward-hacking mitigation.

values.label: Safety-research trustworthiness risk
values.description: Loss of confidence in assurance evidence when deployed agents can undermine safety evaluation or monitoring code.

selected_clusters.name: Reward and Objective Specification
selected_clusters.description: Varies how intended objectives, scoring functions, and multiple reward criteria are specified and exposed for agent evaluation.

values.label: True-objective evaluation
values.description: Evaluates the agent against the intended task objective rather than relying solely on an optimized proxy reward.

includes.label: True-objective evaluation target
includes.description: Uses the intended task objective, rather than only the optimized proxy reward, as the quality reference.

values.label: Multi-objective evaluation
values.description: Specifies and evaluates several objective dimensions together, rather than reducing success to a single scalar proxy.

includes.label: True-objective evaluation target
includes.description: Uses the intended task objective, rather than only the optimized proxy reward, as the quality reference.

includes.label: Multi-objective reward specification
includes.description: Represents multiple aspects of success rather than optimizing a single scalar proxy.

values.label: Transparent multi-objective evaluation
values.description: Combines intended-objective evaluation and multiple reward criteria with scoring logic exposed to the evaluated agent.

includes.label: True-objective evaluation target
includes.description: Uses the intended task objective, rather than only the optimized proxy reward, as the quality reference.

includes.label: Multi-objective reward specification
includes.description: Represents multiple aspects of success rather than optimizing a single scalar proxy.

includes.label: Agent-visible scoring function
includes.description: Exposes correctness and performance scoring logic to the evaluated agent.

dropped_dimensions.rationale: Dropped because it primarily concerns training-time reward shaping, regularization, adversarial training, and optimization mitigation rather than the architecture of monitoring infrastructure after deployment. Its outcomes may inform monitoring, but the dimension itself represents mitigation choices outside the use case.

Dropped because it concerns the broad computational and organizational architecture for training or operating RL agents, rather than decisions specific to building post-deployment monitoring infrastructure. Monitoring-relevant deployment concerns are captured more directly by telemetry, detection, updating, governance, and training-serving integration dimensions.
